page.description: Manage and configure chat bot prompt settings

form.customErrorMessageHelp: When this prompt's LLM request fails (for example, connection failures), this error reply is sent first. Leave empty to use the default error message.
form.presetDialogsHelp: Add some preset dialogs to help the bot better understand the role settings. The number of dialogs must be even (users and assistants take turns).
form.toolsHelp: Select available tools for this prompt. Tools allow the bot to perform specific functions such as searching, calculating, getting information, etc.
form.builtinToolDisabledHint: Builtin tools cannot be enabled or disabled here yet. Please enable or disable the corresponding config items in the config file.
form.skillsHelp: Select available Skills for this prompt. Skills provide reusable workflows and guidance.
form.skillsRuntimeNoneWarning: Computer Use runtime is set to None; Skills may not run correctly because no runtime is enabled.
